paper.title_en: Conformal boundary rigidity from null geodesic travel times
paper.abstract_en: The gravitational field of a distant, isolated system is manifested by the conformally invariant Weyl tensor. Thus the conformal structure far from the system encodes the system's gravitational mass. It also encodes the causal structure, thereby linking it to the mass. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes, this link led to a novel positive mass theorem of Page, Surya, and the second author \cite{PSW} which did not rely on any traditional energy condition. Here we ask whether that theorem has a rigidity case. Specifically, we consider all null geodesics in an asymptotically AdS spacetime that depart from the Penrose conformal infinity, travel through spacetime, and return to conformal infinity. If all such geodesics from a given point refocus at an antipodal point at infinity, is the spacetime conformal to anti-de Sitter space? It is easy to answer the question if the asymptotically AdS spacetime either (i) obeys the null energy condition in 3 or 4 spacetime dimensions, or (ii) is static (in any dimension), and we give simple proofs in those cases. We then answer the question in the case of globally stationary, asymptotically AdS spacetimes, by applying the theory of magnetic geodesics on the Riemannian manifold-with-boundary obtained by quotienting by the stationary Killing vector field. The question has an analogue for asymptotically flat spacetimes, which we also discuss.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了渐近反德西特时空中零测地线的共形边界刚性，将正质量定理的刚性情形与磁测地线理论联系起来，方法新颖，具有较高的理论深度和数学严谨性。
decision.title_zh: 来自零测地线传播时间的共形边界刚性
decision.abstract_zh: 遥远孤立系统的引力场由其共形不变的Weyl张量体现。因此，远离系统的共形结构编码了系统的引力质量。它还编码了因果结构，从而将其与质量联系起来。对于渐近反德西特（AdS）时空，这种联系导致了Page、Surya和第二作者\cite{PSW}提出的一个新颖的正质量定理，该定理不依赖于任何传统的能量条件。这里我们询问该定理是否具有刚性情形。具体来说，我们考虑渐近AdS时空中的所有零测地线，它们从彭罗斯共形无穷远出发，穿过时空，并返回共形无穷远。如果从某一点出发的所有此类测地线在无穷远的对跖点重新聚焦，那么时空是否共形于反德西特空间？如果渐近AdS时空（i）在3维或4维时空中服从零能量条件，或（ii）是静态的（任何维度），则很容易回答这个问题，我们在这些情况下给出简单的证明。然后，我们通过应用在通过平稳Killing向量场求商得到的带边界黎曼流形上的磁测地线理论，回答了全局平稳渐近AdS时空的情况。这个问题对于渐近平坦时空也有类似物，我们也对此进行了讨论。
